content: आत् The letter आ. {%ind.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Afterwards, then; generally used antithetically to यद्, यदा, यदि and then sometimes strengthened by the particles अह, उ, इद् <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Then, further, also, and (अपि च). .²3 Some-times it only strengthens the meaning of another word or gives emphasis to an interrogative pronoun like उ, अङ्ग, नु added to किम् (possibly, at all).
